# Belfast Gophers

> Belfast Gophers, also known as the Go Belfast User Group (GBUG), is a free community in Belfast, Northern Ireland, for anyone interested in the Go programming language. It has met since June 2016, with talks, food and drink, and a live stream of every meet-up.

Meet-ups are listed, and people sign up for them, on Meetup. Recordings of past talks are on YouTube. The group follows the Go Community Code of Conduct.

## The group

- [Home](https://belfastgophers.com/): about the group and its next meet-up
- [Meetup](https://www.meetup.com/belfast-gophers/): meet-ups and signing up for them
- [Speak](https://belfastgophers.com/speak): offer a talk
- [Sponsors](https://belfastgophers.com/sponsors): who supports the group, and how to sponsor it
- [Code of Conduct](https://belfastgophers.com/code-of-conduct): how members are expected to behave, and how to report a problem
